free_resources.title: Meditation Audio
free_resources.description: A free page of guided recordings from Laura's Practical Intuition work: preparations and prologues for intuitive and healing readings, and a short morning practice from The Circle. Further meditations are grouped by the way a person tends to respond to a crisis, such as anxiety, rage, denial or depression.

flags: Restored under the new health rule: the page says the recordings create 'states of relaxation, intuition and healing' and groups meditations by crisis response type (anxiety, rage, denial, depression). Two recordings are preparations for a 'healing reading' in her Practical Intuition method; the page makes no claim to cure or treat any condition and says nothing about medication. A human may want to look at the 'healing reading' wording.
lauraday.com sets Crawl-delay: 10; pages were read with a timed wait, and the image is the page's own og:image (a site-wide hero picture), set as final so the dry run doesn't fetch there.
